input.quote: unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: § 3.2 renews each Service Option Attachment automatically but requires ninety (90) days' notice to stop renewal, exceeding our fallback ceiling of a non-renewal notice window of no more than sixty (60) days. Our single edit changes only the numeral so the window is "at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term", restoring the original verb construction and leaving the mutual notice right, the writing requirement and the term-end trigger verbatim; that lands the clause at the fallback. No provision permits a renewal price increase — Charges are fixed by the Service Option Attachments and Order Forms (§ 4.1) — so the conditional 5 percent uplift element is satisfied on the document's own terms. Preferred-only points noted, not redlined: renewal is automatic rather than by mutual agreement, the opt-out is 60 not 30 days, there is no Vendor reminder, and renewal terms track the previous term rather than a 12-month cap. For the deal team: any attachment with a term over 12 months would produce an automatic multi-year renewal (walk-away territory) and should be escalated or fixed with a twelve (12) month renewal cap.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have changed only the numeral in § 3.2 so the non-renewal notice period is sixty (60) days rather than ninety (90), matching our fallback 60-day window; our preferred position is a 30-day opt-out with a Vendor renewal reminder.
proposal.summary: Reduce the § 3.2 non-renewal notice period from ninety (90) to sixty (60) days.
